decision_rule: SUPPORTED when the applicant spelling matches an entity name in the collected jurisdiction filing of the attributed organization (exact match after NFC+casefold+punctuation collapse, or the entity name contains the spelling's distinctive token sequence as whole words), or when a verified ownership relation in medradar/product/attribution/ownership.json covers the spelling for that organization. CONTRADICTED only when the collected filing shows a different organization owns that exact entity name. UNDECIDABLE when no collected documentary source names the spelling: the case is excluded from the precision numerator and denominator and reported separately. No case is scored correct on the basis of the registry's own claim.
sampling_note: Stratified, deterministic sample drawn from the committed snapshot with a fixed seed. The estimate is over decidable cases only; the undecidable share is reported so the denominator cannot be silently inflated.
caveats: The reviewer is an AI agent applying a documentary rule, not a human analyst. This is NOT independent human review.
Only organizations with a collected jurisdiction filing (Medtronic, GE HealthCare, Philips) can be decided; the other tracked organizations are infrastructure-limited, not verified.
The filing lists subsidiaries above a disclosure threshold, so a missing entity is undecidable, never contradicted.
No contradicted case was found in this sample; that is a statement about the sample, not a guarantee about the population.
